f310344361e6b851.description: About TechnipFMC and the Role TechnipFMC is dedicated to advancing the energy industry towards a sustainable future through innovation and global collaboration. This full-time position for an Associate Engineer, Product Surface, is based in Dhahran, Eastern Province, and offers a career within a culture that values curiosity, expertise, and inclusion. The role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Role Purpose The Associate Engineer participates in engineering solutions as part of a Subsea Systems Engineering (SSE) project taskforce. This role requires adherence to TechnipFMC standards, procedures, processes, schedules, and budget, with a continuous focus on quality, project targets, and customer satisfaction. The Associate Engineer provides technical support to internal and external customers for ongoing projects and field operations, performs original design and layout work for new or modified products, and applies engineering theory, mathematics, and practical mechanics to solve design and operational problems. Key Responsibilities Participate in projects under the supervision of senior engineers and provide assistance on various engineering topics. Offer technical assistance within projects and at manufacturing, fabrication, and installation sites. Write and issue technical specifications and reports related to assigned activities within SSE projects and/or operations. Assist in developing design bases for projects and/or manufacturing operations. Serve as a technical resource to project teams, manufacturing, MMR, workshop, warehouse, tool pool, HSEQ, and FSTs. Adhere to all TechnipFMC rules and procedures for Engineering, Quality, Environment, Health, and Safety. Create and check Technical Change Engineering (TCE) and other engineering documentation through the Engineering Change Notice (ECN) process. Participate in design reviews and prepare engineering calculations. Create and review procedures and work instructions for mobilization, demobilization, maintenance, refurbishment, and repair activities. Perform dispositions of Quality and Service Notifications. Provide support during refurbishment/remanufacture activities, evaluating and approving concessions/deviations as required. Participate in technical meetings internally and with clients/suppliers. Provide support for local HSEQ activities, including Root Cause Analyses (RCAs), Hazard and Operability (HAZOP) studies, and Risk Assessments. Attend System Integration Tests (SITs). May be deployed on-site for new product installation and commissioning. Experience and Qualifications This role requires 0-1 years of relevant experience. Candidates should possess a foundational understanding of engineering principles and a commitment to continuous learning and professional development within the energy industry. Work Environment The position is based in Dhahran, Eastern Province, and operates within a collaborative team environment. The role may involve occasional on-site assignments for product installation and commissioning. Application Process TechnipFMC is committed to building a sustainable future. Qualified candidates are encouraged to apply.

f3838daeffb41151.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مشرق العمارة للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس إنشائي للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الخبر. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تخطيط وتصميم وتحليل العناصر والمنشآت الإنشائية، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف الفني على تنفيذ الأعمال. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تخطيط وتصميم العناصر والمنشآت الإنشائية بناءً على الأحمال المقدرة، وتحديد حجمها وشكلها ومقاومتها ونوعها. إجراء التحليل الإنشائي للعناصر، بما فيها العناصر مسبقة التصميم، وتحليل الإجهادات وإجراء الحسابات الإنشائية. إعداد ومراجعة مخططات وخطط تركيب العناصر الإنشائية. التحقق من مطابقة التصاميم والمخططات للأكواد والاشتراطات المعتمدة. الإشراف فنيًا على تنفيذ الأعمال الإنشائية ومتابعة جودتها وسلامتها. تفقد المنشآت القائمة، والتوصية بإصلاح العناصر الإنشائية المعيبة أو استبدالها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونتائجها ونسب تقدمها. عرض وتوضيح وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقًا للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة الإنشائية. القدرة على تخطيط وتصميم وتحليل العناصر والمنشآت الإنشائية. معرفة قوية بالأكواد والاشتراطات الهندسية المعتمدة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لإجراء التحليلات الإنشائية وحساب الإجهادات. القدرة على مراجعة المخططات والحسابات الإنشائية. مهارات الإشراف الفني ومتابعة جودة وسلامة الأعمال الإنشائية. القدرة على إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مشرق العمارة للاستشارات الهندسية، ويقع في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهندسين الإنشائيين المؤهلين للتقديم على هذا الدور للانضمام إلى فريقنا.

f3973b1c02b362cc.description: Lead the development and execution of long-term transport and mobility strategies that support organizational, regional, and development objectives. Provide executive leadership in shaping integrated, sustainable, and future-ready transportation systems through strategic planning, policy development, stakeholder engagement, and investment prioritization. Drive mobility transformation initiatives by aligning transport networks, infrastructure investments, emerging technologies, and operational models with growth and economic development objectives. Section III: KEY RESPONSIBILITIES/ ACCOUNTABILITIES Key Responsibilities • Develop and lead the organization's transport and mobility strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives, master plans, and regional development goals. • Define strategic transport policies, frameworks, and planning principles to support integrated mobility solutions. • Lead the evaluation of transport investment opportunities, infrastructure priorities, and mobility programs. • Oversee transport strategy studies, mobility assessments, corridor planning, and multimodal transportation initiatives. • Direct the development of long-term transport demand strategies and future mobility scenarios. • Collaborate with Development, Urban Planning, Infrastructure, Smart City, Sustainability, and Operations teams to ensure integrated planning outcomes. • Lead engagement with government entities, transport authorities, regulators, and strategic partners on mobility and transportation matters. • Monitor global transportation trends, mobility innovations, emerging technologies, and regulatory developments to inform strategic decision-making. • Support business case development, investment evaluations, and funding strategies for transport-related initiatives. • Provide strategic guidance on public transport, active mobility, intelligent transport systems, autonomous mobility, and mobility-as-a-service initiatives. • Present strategic recommendations, policy proposals, and transport performance insights to executive leadership and governance committees. • Lead and develop high-performing transport strategy teams while promoting innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Section IV: KEY INTERACTIONS Key Internal Interactions • Executive Leadership Team • Development Teams • Urban Planning Teams • Infrastructure and Engineering Teams • Smart City and Digital Teams • Sustainability Teams • Finance and Development Finance Teams • Operations and Asset Management Teams Key External Interactions • Government Authorities • Transport Authorities • Regulatory Bodies • Strategic Partners • Consultants • Academic and Research Institutions • Infrastructure Operators • Investors and Funding Agencies Knowledge Minimum Qualifications • Bachelor's degree in Transportation Planning, Civil Engineering, Urban Planning, Public Policy, Economics, Geography, or a related field. • Master's degree in Transportation Planning, Urban Planning, Public Policy, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline preferred. Professional Certifications • PTP (Professional Transportation Planner), PMP, AICP, CTP, or equivalent professional certification preferred. Skills • Transport strategy development • Mobility planning • Transportation policy and governance • Infrastructure planning • Strategic planning and investment evaluation • Stakeholder engagement • Transport economics • Data-driven decision-making • Executive communication and presentation • Leadership and organizational development Experience Years of Experience • 15+ years of progressive experience in transportation planning, mobility strategy, infrastructure planning, urban development, or related disciplines. Nature of Experience • Developing and implementing transport and mobility strategies for large-scale cities, destinations, infrastructure programs, or regional developments. • Leading strategic planning initiatives involving government authorities, transport agencies, and executive stakeholders. • Managing multidisciplinary teams and external advisors. • Supporting major transportation investments, policy development, and mobility transformation programs. • Advising executive leadership on transportation strategy, mobility innovation, and infrastructure priorities.

f3121aa29cf81b18.description: About the Role Humanoid is seeking a Head of MENA to lead the company's commercial expansion across the Middle East and North Africa, with an initial focus on Saudi Arabia and the GCC. This full-time role involves establishing a regional presence, developing strategic customer relationships, and driving the commercial adoption of humanoid robotics across various markets including enterprise, industrial, logistics, manufacturing, government, and public sectors. The Head of MENA will own the regional go-to-market strategy, build and execute the sales pipeline, and develop strategic partnerships. This position requires representing Humanoid with senior executives, sovereign entities, and industry leaders, working closely with the executive team to establish MENA as a key growth market. Key Responsibilities Own and execute Humanoid's commercial strategy across MENA, with an initial focus on Saudi Arabia and the GCC. Build and manage the regional sales pipeline from strategic introductions through to contract execution. Develop relationships with C-suite executives, government stakeholders, sovereign wealth funds, ministries, and major enterprise customers. Secure commercial agreements, pilot programmes, strategic partnerships, and pre-orders for Humanoid's robotics platform. Identify high-value market opportunities across manufacturing, logistics, automotive, energy, healthcare, defence, and smart cities. Develop commercial business cases and ROI models to accelerate customer adoption. Represent Humanoid at executive meetings, industry events, and strategic customer engagements across the region. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Leadership teams to integrate customer feedback into product development and go-to-market strategy. Own regional revenue targets, forecasting, and commercial performance. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of commercial leadership experience in robotics, automation, industrial technology, AI, or advanced manufacturing. Proven experience building and scaling enterprise sales across the Middle East, particularly Saudi Arabia and the GCC. Demonstrated success in selling complex technical solutions to enterprise, government, or sovereign customers. Established network across key regional organisations, including major enterprises, government entities, and strategic partners. Experience leading strategic partnerships and managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles. Strong commercial acumen with experience owning revenue targets, forecasting, and business planning. Exceptional executive presence with strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills. Ability to operate independently in a fast-moving, early-stage environment and build new markets.

f340bcc1ffbe8235.description: About the Role Johns Hopkins Aramco Healthcare (JHAH) is seeking a Mortuary Technician to join our team in Al-Ahsa or Dhahran. This is a full-time technical position responsible for the dignified, safe, and hygienic operation of the hospital mortuary. The role ensures strict adherence to Ministry of Health (MOH) infection control protocols, maintains the physical chain of custody for deceased patients, and manages environmental safety standards within the cold storage facility. This position requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Receive bodies from clinical wards, verifying "Dual Identifier" tags and accurately documenting the chain of custody in the Morgue Register. Monitor and record temperature and humidity levels of cold chambers in accordance with established policies and procedures, reporting any deviations immediately. Coordinate terminal cleaning and disinfection of storage units, hydraulic lifts, and all surfaces using hospital-grade agents. Apply specific MOH precautions, including shrouding and bagging, for high-risk infectious bodies (*, COVID-19, MERS). Assist forensic authorities with body identification and sample preservation in cases requiring police involvement. Physically release bodies to authorized families or municipality services, ensuring all protocols are followed. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 0-1 years of relevant experience is required for this position. Demonstrated understanding and adherence to infection control protocols, particularly those set by the Ministry of Health. Ability to maintain accurate records and documentation. Work Environment This role operates within a hospital mortuary setting, requiring strict adherence to hygiene and safety standards. The position is based in either Al-Ahsa or Dhahran and is a full-time commitment. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

f3946152cd2f71ed.job_title: Culinary Leaders Needed: Junior Sous Chef – French Concept - Al Khobar
f3946152cd2f71ed.description: Job Details Location: Al Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia Position Type: Full-Time, Permanent Department: Back of House (Reporting to the Sous Chef) Compensation: 8,000 SAR Monthly About the Opportunity We are partnering with a highly regarded, casual neighbourhood dining destination in Al Khobar where French Riviera spirit meets everyday city life. Known for exceptional food, warm hospitality, and executing simple things beautifully, this upscale kitchen is looking for a driven culinary professional to bridge the gap between the pass and the team. The Role As a Junior Sous Chef, you will support the Sous Chef and Head Chef in daily kitchen management. You will serve as both a technical anchor and an emerging leader—overseeing preparation, maintaining rigorous standards, and stepping up to run the line when the team needs you most. Your Profile & Experience Experience: 3 to 4 years of solid kitchen background, including at least 1 to 2 years as a Chef de Partie or Junior Sous Chef within a fine dining or upscale environment. Foundation: Strong technical culinary skills paired with a keen eye for consistency, organization, and clear leadership potential. Traits: Disciplined, adaptable, and highly consistent. High-volume services do not shake your composure; you stay focused, set the right tone, and keep the team moving forward. Language: English fluency is mandatory. Additional language skills such as French or Arabic are highly advantageous. Core Responsibilities Technical Excellence & Standards: Oversee food preparation, cooking, and plating to ensure absolute precision, consistency, and quality across every section during every service. Leadership & Mentoring: Motivate, train, and support the kitchen brigade, leading by example and stepping in to command the kitchen operations when necessary. Hygiene & Safety: Strictly enforce food safety and hygiene protocols across all stations, ensuring a compliant and spotless working environment at all times. Organization & Adaptability: Manage inventory control, stock rotation, and kitchen flow, seamlessly adjusting to the shifting demands of busy services.

f310fe964543935c.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الواكد للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور على الإشراف الهندسي وإدارة المشاريع الإنشائية، بدءًا من دراسة الموقع وحتى تسليم المشروع، مع ضمان مطابقة جميع الأعمال للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع بدقة. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. متابعة إعداد جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية وتدقيقها. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع لضمان مطابقة المواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بنتائج الأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسبة تقدمها، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية والمقاولات. إلمام قوي بدراسة المواقع الإنشائية وتحليل التربة. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية وتدقيق المخططات وجداول الكميات. مهارات إشرافية ممتازة لضمان جودة التنفيذ ومطابقة المواصفات. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة الواكد للمقاولات في مشاريعها بمدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. تتطلب الوظيفة التواجد في مواقع المشاريع والإشراف المباشر على سير العمل. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المدنيين المؤهلين والذين تتوافر لديهم الخبرة المطلوبة للتقدم لهذه الفرصة. سيتم التواصل مع المرشحين المستوفين للشروط لمناقشة تفاصيل الدور.

f31a7b207e226be6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الأركان الفاخرة للمقاولات عن فني كهربائي تمديدات كهربائية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية، وتقدير المواد اللازمة، ومتابعة تنفيذ الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص الأعطال ومعالجتها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مخططات التمديدات الكهربائية للمشاريع المنزلية، الصناعية، والتجارية ومكوناتها. تقدير كميات المواد والأجهزة الكهربائية المطلوبة وتأمين التجهيزات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات، مع التأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات. متابعة تنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الكهربائية، ومراقبة تشغيل الدارات الكهربائية، وإجراء الفحوصات اللازمة مثل فحوص العازلية والاستمرارية والتأريض. تشخيص أعطال التمديدات الكهربائية وتحديد الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة لمعالجتها، بالإضافة إلى متابعة أعمال الصيانة الوقائية. تطبيق جميع إجراءات وتعليمات السلامة والصحة المهنية في بيئة العمل. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التمديدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وفهم المخططات الكهربائية. معرفة جيدة بمعايير السلامة والصحة المهنية. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص في مشاريع المقاولات المتنوعة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

f33af9a6d6d50e9e.job_title: Employee Life Cycle Team Lead HR Shared Services

This full-time role involves developing and implementing the HR Service Center strategy in alignment with Lumi’s overall objectives. The manager will lead the HR Service Center team, oversee HR operations, and ensure compliance with company policies and Saudi labor laws. Role Overview The Head of HCM Service Center is responsible for the strategic direction and operational excellence of HR services. This includes monitoring performance, driving continuous improvement across HR services, and providing expert counsel to Lumi’s leadership. The role requires a professional with 5-10 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute HR Service Center strategies aligned with the company’s overall goals. Lead and manage the HR Service Center team by setting objectives, monitoring performance, and motivating the team to achieve high performance. Oversee daily HR operations and ensure compliance with company policies and local labor laws. Provide effective solutions for HR-related inquiries and complaints. f35f434783f71100.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قنبر للخرسانة الجاهزة عن كاتب عمليات نقل للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تنسيق ودعم العمليات اليومية لإنتاج وتوجيه ونقل وتسليم الخرسانة الجاهزة. يعمل شاغل الوظيفة كحلقة وصل أساسية بين المصنع، أقسام الجودة والصيانة والمبيعات والحجوزات، والعملاء لضمان تنفيذ خطط الإنتاج والتسليم بكفاءة وسلامة وفي الوقت المحدد. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنسيق جداول الإنتاج والتسليم والتواصل اليومي الفعال بين جميع الجهات المعنية. تنظيم حركة الشاحنات ومتابعة عمليات التسليم، بما في ذلك التأخيرات والإلغاءات وإعادة الجدولة. التنسيق مع أقسام الحجوزات والمبيعات فيما يتعلق بالطلبات الواردة والطاقة الإنتاجية المتاحة. إبلاغ المصنع وقسم الجودة بالأولويات ومتابعة أي مشكلات قد تؤثر على الإنتاج. متابعة توفر أسطول الشاحنات، ورصد الأعطال، والتنسيق بشأن أعمال الصيانة التي تؤثر على التشغيل. التنسيق مع العملاء والمقاولين والمواقع لضمان جاهزية التسليم واستلام الخرسانة. رصد حالات التعطل واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة، وتصعيد المشكلات الكبرى عند الضرورة. دعم إجراءات السلامة والإبلاغ عن أي حوادث أو مخاطر محتملة. توثيق بيانات الإنتاج والتسليم وحركة الشاحنات والتأخيرات، وإعداد التقارير الدورية. اقتراح تحسينات على الجدولة واستغلال الشاحنات لزيادة كفاءة العمليات. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التنسيق والتواصل الفعال مع مختلف الأقسام والجهات الخارجية. مهارات تنظيمية قوية والقدرة على إدارة المهام المتعددة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب التزاماً بضمان سير عمليات النقل بسلاسة وكفاءة ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

f3c889ec8b6aaf32.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مصنع عماد ابراهيم الفت حلواني للمعجنات عن أخصائي جودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تصميم وتطبيق معايير الجودة، وتقييم رضا العملاء، وتطوير أنظمة التدقيق لضمان أعلى مستويات الجودة في الخدمات والمنتجات. المسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل وتصميم أدلة ونماذج إدارة الجودة، وتحديد وتطوير مواصفات ومعايير ومؤشرات لمختلف العمليات والمخرجات. المساهمة في تطوير معايير ومواصفات الجودة المطلوبة للمبادرات والبرامج والمخرجات قيد التطوير، بما يتماشى مع خطط العمل المحددة. إعداد وتطوير استبيانات لقياس مستوى رضا العملاء عن جودة الخدمات والإجراءات، وتوثيق وتحليل توصياتهم التحسينية. تطوير أنظمة وإجراءات ونماذج تدقيق الجودة، والمشاركة في وضع خطط التدقيق الدوري والسنوي، وتنفيذ عمليات ضبط وتدقيق الجودة بدقة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالجودة، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الجودة. القدرة على تصميم أدلة ونماذج إدارة الجودة. فهم جيد لمعايير ومواصفات الجودة وتطبيقها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لدراسة مستوى رضا العملاء. القدرة على تطوير أنظمة وإجراءات تدقيق الجودة. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة، المملكة العربية السعودية. ستعمل ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة في جميع جوانب العمليات والخدمات. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق ملتزم بتحسين الجودة المستمر.

f3c99a3c3dc104aa.description: About the Role KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is seeking an SAP Functional Analyst specializing in SAP S/4HANA Sales and Order to Cash. This full-time position is located in Thuwal, Makkah, and involves shaping the university's end-to-end sales, contracting, fulfillment, billing, and revenue processes. The role focuses on setting functional direction, simplifying legacy practices, and translating institutional needs into scalable solutions on KAUST’s SAP platform. Role Context and Impact The SAP Functional Analyst will lead a prioritized functional roadmap, promoting fit-to-standard and clean-core design principles. This position involves collaboration with business process owners, enterprise architecture, and delivery teams on integration, data, user experience, and change management. The analyst will evaluate SAP Fiori, workflow, analytics, SAP Business Technology Platform, and Business AI capabilities to address defined business problems and measure outcomes through process performance, adoption, and controls. Key Responsibilities Own the functional roadmap for Sales and Order to Cash, ensuring alignment with KAUST strategy, business process owners, enterprise architecture, and SAP platform plans. Lead end-to-end process design across inquiries, quotations, contracts, sales orders, fulfillment, pricing, billing, receivables, and revenue recognition, adapting standard capabilities to KAUST’s research, education, and commercial activities as justified. Facilitate fit-to-standard decisions with stakeholders, challenging duplicate steps and unnecessary customization, documenting material deviations, and recommending upgrade-safe options under clean-core principles. Define business requirements and functional design for integration with Finance, Materials Management, Grants Management, revenue accounting, credit management, point-of-sale, and relevant non-SAP platforms, adhering to KAUST’s approved architecture. Partner with data owners to enhance customer, product, pricing, contract, and transaction data quality, including ownership, controls, and reporting definitions. Guide the design of role-based SAP Fiori experiences, approvals, workflow, and embedded analytics, involving users early and measuring the impact on task efficiency and reliability. Assess automation and SAP Business AI or Joule use cases based on value, data protection, human oversight, and platform readiness before recommending adoption. Provide functional leadership in transformation initiatives, including solution evaluation, delivery assurance, business acceptance, cutover readiness, and post-implementation benefits tracking; direct specialist configuration and testing through delivery teams. Advise on controls, segregation of duties, and auditability within the order-to-cash process in collaboration with Finance, Information Security, and risk owners. Maintain relationships with business leaders, SAP partners, and internal technology teams, translating complex options into clear decisions, trade-offs, costs, and measurable outcomes. Required Experience and Skills 5-10 years of experience in a relevant SAP functional role. Ability to work under general direction with substantial autonomy, owning a functional roadmap and prioritized outcomes while escalating material investment, architecture, and policy decisions through established governance. Demonstrated ability to build consensus across Finance, research, commercial, and technology stakeholders, influencing process owners and delivery partners without relying on formal line authority. Proficiency in resolving complex cross-functional process and integration issues, balancing standard SAP capability, university-specific needs, controls, data quality, and long-term maintainability. Strong facilitation, analytical, communication, and change leadership skills. Capability to establish measures of process performance, write clear decision recommendations, manage competing priorities, and coach colleagues in modern SAP ways of working. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Thuwal, Makkah, within the dynamic environment of KAUST. The role requires collaboration across various university departments and external partners. Application Process Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon inquiry. Salary for this position is not disclosed.

f3cf23656cc7b9ec.description: About the Role DAR ENGINEERING is seeking an experienced Document Control and Data Management Manager to lead the document control and information management function for large-scale projects in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for establishing and governing how project information is created, controlled, shared, and archived, ensuring accurate, traceable, and secure records that meet contractual, client, and regulatory requirements. The successful candidate will combine strong technical knowledge of document and content management systems with proven leadership of document control teams, acting as a trusted partner to project managers, design teams, clients, and contractors. Key Responsibilities Define and implement document control strategies, policies, procedures, and standards in line with contractual requirements, client standards, and international best practices. Establish performance targets and key performance indicators (KPIs) for the function, and monitor and report on performance against these targets. Define metadata requirements, document numbering systems, naming conventions, classification structures, workflows, access rights, and security protocols. Manage the controlled flow of project documentation, including drawings, submittals, requests for information (RFIs), correspondence, meeting minutes, reports, and contractual documents. Prepare and implement project-specific document control and information management plans. Manage project closeout and handover activities, including as-built records, data books, and long-term archiving. Ensure compliance with the quality management system (ISO 9001), client requirements, and applicable Saudi regulations. Implement document retention, confidentiality, and information security requirements, ensuring appropriate access controls for sensitive project data. Support internal and external audits and oversee the implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Prepare regular dashboards and management reports covering document status, workflow performance, and compliance. Train project teams in the use of electronic document management systems (EDMS) and document control procedures, promoting effective information management practices. Monitor developments in document and content management technologies and industry standards, recommending improvements where appropriate. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in document control and data management. Proven leadership experience in managing document control teams. Strong technical knowledge of document and content management systems. Familiarity with contractual, client, and regulatory requirements related to document control. Experience with quality management systems (ISO 9001) and applicable Saudi regulations. Work Environment and Benefits DAR ENGINEERING offers a collaborative work environment with opportunities for professional growth and new challenges. The company provides a competitive salary and benefits package, including comprehensive medical coverage and wellness support. We support a healthy work-life balance through flexible working hours, allowing some flexibility in daily start and finish times while maintaining a structured working schedule of up to 48 hours per week. Application Process Interested candidates are invited to submit their application online. Riyadh-based candidates are preferred, and relocation support is available for qualified talent. DAR Engineering is an Equal Opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, age, marital status, gender identity, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted by our Talent Acquisition team. f37eadbf032218ec.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ملاك المجوهرات عن بائع مجوهرات للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تقديم تجربة تسوق مميزة للعملاء من خلال بيع المجوهرات وتوفير معلومات شاملة عنها، بالإضافة إلى إدارة عمليات الدفع والمخزون بكفاءة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من المجوهرات للعملاء. توفير معلومات دقيقة ومفصلة حول المجوهرات المعروضة وأسعارها. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بشكل دوري لضمان توفر المنتجات. الحفاظ على ترتيب المتجر ونظافته لتقديم بيئة تسوق جذابة. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة عند الحاجة. التعامل مع المنتجات الواردة وترتيبها في المتجر. إتمام عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من العملاء بدقة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقاً لسياسات الشركة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع المجوهرات أو التجزئة. القدرة على التعامل مع العملاء وتقديم خدمة ممتازة. مهارات تواصل قوية ولباقة في التعامل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. نوع العمل هذا الدور متاح بنظام الدوام الكامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. الراتب سيتم تحديد الراتب بعد المقابلة الشخصية، وهو غير معلن في الوقت الحالي. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم للنظر فيها.

f387b656e213c5b6.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة الوجناء للمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة المواقع الإنشائية، وإعداد التصاميم والمخططات، والإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع لضمان مطابقتها للمواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال الهندسي. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع، وتحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة. إجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصر المشروع. إعداد تصاميم المشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية. الإشراف على تنفيذ المشروع ومطابقة المواصفات الفنية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، وتوضيح نسبة تقدمها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية. القدرة على دراسة وتحليل المواقع الإنشائية. مهارة في إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية والمخططات. القدرة على الإشراف على تنفيذ المشاريع ومطابقة المواصفات. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المدني بدوام كامل في مدينة الرياض، ضمن فريق مؤسسة الوجناء للمقاولات. يتطلب الدور التواجد في مواقع المشاريع للإشراف المباشر ومتابعة سير العمل. نطاق الدور يشمل الدور مسؤوليات متعددة تبدأ من مرحلة دراسة الجدوى الفنية للموقع وصولاً إلى الإشراف على التنفيذ النهائي للمشروع، مع التركيز على دقة التصاميم ومطابقة الجودة. يساهم المهندس في إعداد التقارير الفنية الدورية التي توثق تقدم الأعمال. معلومات إضافية هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في الرياض، والراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

f3906a62fb6dd07f.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة المساكن العصرية للمقاولات عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إدارة المستندات المالية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وإعداد التقارير المحاسبية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المحاسبة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية مجموعة من المهام المالية والإدارية لضمان دقة السجلات والتقارير. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. متابعة تحصيل الإيرادات وتوثيقها وتحليلها بشكل دوري. تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من اكتمال شروطها القانونية والمالية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات المحاسبية. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بما يتوافق مع الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة في مجال محاسبة النفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. تطوير الأساليب المحاسبية يُتوقع من المحاسب في هذا الدور أن يساهم في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة المتبعة في الشركة. يشمل ذلك مواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في مجال المحاسبة لضمان تطبيق أفضل الممارسات وتحسين الكفاءة التشغيلية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية بدقة. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإعداد التقارير المالية. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي لدعم العمليات المحاسبية لشركة المساكن العصرية للمقاولات. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة المساكن العصرية للمقاولات.

f3d1c392a90d79a8.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة عن فني تدفئة وتهوية وتكييف للانضمام إلى فريقها في بريدة، القصيم. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة تركيب وصيانة وتصليح معدات التكييف والتدفئة والتهوية، بما في ذلك وحدات ومضخات التدفئة ومكيفات الهواء. الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساهمة في عملية تصميم نظم التهوية وتكييف الهواء والتدفئة، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشروعات الهندسية، ومباشرة تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم، ووضع الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. تقديم الدعم في أعمال الصيانة وتصليح النظم. مراقبة الجوانب الفنية المتصلة بإنتاج وتركيب واستعمال وصيانة منظومات وأجهزة ومعدات التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف للتأكد من دقة الأداء ومطابقة المواصفات. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تركيب وصيانة وتصليح أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية وتكييف الهواء. فهم جيد لمكونات أنظمة التدفئة والتهوية والتكييف (HVAC) ومبادئ عملها. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات الفنية والرسومات الهندسية. المهارات والكفاءات مهارات قوية في حل المشكلات والتشخيص الفني. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل تُعد هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة بريدة، القصيم، ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على الجودة والالتزام بالمعايير المهنية. تقديم الطلبات للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى شركة تكامل المرافق للتشغيل والصيانة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم. سيتم تحديد الراتب بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

f3912a964b35afa2.description: About Us Moneymoon is a pioneering Fintech platform transforming short-term microlending through secure, compliant, and seamless peer-to-peer technology. We enable individuals to support one another through a one-month lending model built on transparency, safety, and trust. As we progress through the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) Regulatory Sandbox and prepare for full licensing, strong AML controls, regulatory compliance, customer protection, and effective governance are critical to our mission. Your Role We’re looking for an AML & Compliance Specialist to support Moneymoon’s AML, regulatory compliance, monitoring, and control activities. In this role, you will help ensure that our operations, customer journeys, financing activities, policies, and internal processes remain aligned with applicable regulatory requirements, particularly those issued by the Saudi Central Bank (SAMA). You will work across both AML and Compliance, supporting customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, regulatory research, compliance testing, policy reviews, regulatory tracking, and internal reporting. This role is ideal for a fresh graduate who is highly curious, analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to build a career in compliance and financial crime within a fast-moving fintech environment. You will also be encouraged to use AI, automation, and modern productivity tools to make regulatory research, monitoring, documentation, and analysis faster, smarter, and more efficient. Your Responsibilities AML & Financial Crime • Support customer due diligence and KYC reviews to ensure required customer information and documentation are complete and accurate. • Review customer profiles and financing activities to identify unusual or potentially suspicious behavior. • Support transaction monitoring activities and review alerts generated through AML or fraud monitoring scenarios. • Assist in identifying suspicious patterns, customer behavior, transaction trends, and financial crime risks. • Support enhanced due diligence activities for higher-risk customers or cases when required. • Maintain accurate AML case records, investigation notes, evidence, and supporting documentation. • Escalate unusual or suspicious activities to the relevant Compliance and AML stakeholders. • Support the review and periodic improvement of AML monitoring scenarios and internal controls. • Assist with AML-related reporting, trackers, dashboards, and regulatory documentation. • Support internal reviews relating to potential AML breaches or control gaps. Regulatory Compliance • Monitor SAMA circulars, regulatory updates, guidance, and applicable regulatory requirements. • Support regulatory research and translate applicable requirements into clear internal actions. • Assist in maintaining Moneymoon’s regulatory obligations tracker and follow up on implementation across relevant teams. • Support the development, review, and maintenance of compliance policies, procedures, standards, and internal controls. • Perform compliance monitoring and testing activities to assess adherence to regulatory requirements and internal policies. • Support compliance risk assessments and help identify control gaps, regulatory risks, and required remediation actions. • Review business processes, customer journeys, products, initiatives, and internal practices from a compliance perspective. • Document compliance observations, recommendations, and action items and follow up on agreed remediation. • Support investigations into potential regulatory breaches, policy violations, and compliance concerns. • Maintain accurate compliance registers, trackers, records, and supporting evidence. • Support the preparation of compliance reports, regulatory updates, monitoring results, and management materials. • Assist with regulatory examinations, internal audits, and independent compliance reviews by preparing evidence and supporting documentation. • Support compliance training and awareness activities across the company. • Work closely with Operations, Risk, Cybersecurity, Finance, Product, Technology, Data & AI, and other teams to strengthen regulatory and AML controls. AI, Automation & Process Improvement • Use AI tools and automation to support regulatory research, document reviews, control testing, reporting, and compliance monitoring. • Explore ways to simplify repetitive AML and compliance tasks through automation and smarter workflows. • Use AI-assisted analysis to help identify patterns, inconsistencies, regulatory gaps, and potential risk areas. • Support the development of more efficient compliance trackers, dashboards, templates, and monitoring processes. • Stay up to date with developments in RegTech, AI-enabled compliance, AML technology, and financial crime prevention. Your Expertise • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Risk Management, Compliance, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field. • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. • Previous COOP or internship experience is highly preferred, especially within a fintech, startup, banking, financial services, compliance, AML, risk, audit, or regulatory environment. • Exposure to a fast-paced startup or fintech environment is considered a strong advantage. • Interest in AML, regulatory compliance, financial crime, fintech regulation, and SAMA requirements. • Strong analytical skills and excellent attention to detail. • Ability to read regulations, policies, and procedures and translate them into practical actions. • Strong problem-solving mindset and ability to identify gaps or inconsistencies. • Strong written and verbal communication skills. • Good organizational and time-management skills. • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively in a fast-moving environment. • Good knowledge of Microsoft Excel is preferred. • Familiarity with AI tools, automation, data analysis tools, or modern productivity platforms is highly preferred. • Knowledge of SQL, Python, BI tools, or workflow automation tools is a plus. • Strong sense of ownership, integrity, confidentiality, and professional judgment. • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams. • Fluency in Arabic and English. What We’re Looking For You are curious and naturally interested in understanding how regulations work, why controls exist, and how risks can be prevented before they become problems. You are comfortable reading regulations, reviewing details, asking questions, and challenging inconsistencies when something does not make sense. You are also highly interested in AI and technology and actively look for ways to use them to work faster, reduce manual effort, and improve the quality of compliance and AML activities. You do not need years of experience, but you do need a strong willingness to learn, take ownership, and grow quickly. You enjoy working in a startup environment where priorities move fast, responsibilities are broad, and people are expected to contribute beyond the boundaries of their job title. Most importantly, you are excited to build your career in AML, regulatory compliance, fintech risk, and AI-enabled compliance while helping Moneymoon build a safe, trusted, and regulator-ready financial platform.

f34080940621fb3b.description: About the Role Ericsson is seeking an Integration Engineer – IMS & UDM for a full-time position in Riyadh. This role involves designing, integrating, configuring, upgrading, and maintaining telecom solutions within customer networks. The engineer will manage end-to-end delivery, working across IMS, UDM, subscriber data, 4G/5G Core, and cloud-native environments. Role Context and Collaboration The Integration Engineer will combine hands-on engineering with direct customer engagement. This position requires collaboration with customer technical teams, product experts, support organizations, and project stakeholders to ensure the successful introduction and maintenance of services in live networks. Key Responsibilities Engage with customers to understand requirements, resolve technical issues, present solutions, and coordinate implementation activities. Analyze network architecture, interfaces, capacity, dependencies, and operational constraints. Prepare and execute High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), Method of Procedure (MoP), implementation, testing, upgrade, and rollback plans. Integrate and configure IMS and UDM network functions with surrounding systems. Perform software upgrades, patches, migrations, feature activation, and post-change validation. Verify licenses, subscribers, interfaces, redundancy, alarms, counters, and operational procedures. Troubleshoot signaling, configuration, performance, and service issues across SIP, Diameter, SS7/SCCP, HTTP/2, REST/SBA, TLS, and IP. Analyze logs, traces, alarms, counters, and packet captures to determine root causes and corrective actions. Support 4G/5G Core, VoLTE, VoNR, VoWiFi, roaming, interworking, and subscriber authentication use cases. Work with virtualized and cloud-native environments, including Kubernetes and CNF/VNF. Support customer acceptance testing, handover, knowledge transfer, and production stabilization. Participate in planned maintenance windows, production changes, migrations, failover testing, and service restoration when required. Working at Ericsson Ericsson offers an environment where individuals can apply their skills to develop solutions for complex problems. The company fosters a diverse and inclusive organization, believing that collaboration among individuals with different experiences drives innovation and future growth. Ericsson is an Equal Opportunity Employer and encourages applicants from all backgrounds.

f34f8d20506c8be7.description: نبذة عن الدور يبحث مجمع سينان لطب الأسنان عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقه في بريدة، القصيم. يتولى المحاسب مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير المالية اللازمة. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم مستندات الصرف ومتابعة تحصيل الإيرادات. معرفة بإعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية. القدرة على تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تحليلية قوية لتوثيق وتحليل الإيرادات والنفقات. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المالية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل الفعال. مهارات تنظيمية عالية لحفظ المستندات والتقارير. بيئة العمل يعمل المحاسب في مجمع سينان لطب الأسنان بمدينة بريدة، القصيم، ضمن بيئة عمل احترافية تدعم النمو والتطور المهني. الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتقدم فرصة للمساهمة في إدارة العمليات المالية للمجمع. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة الشخصية.

f36a031bb3a19541.description: About the Role Baja is seeking a Hygiene Supervisor to lead the implementation and monitoring of hygiene and sanitation standards across its coffee, seed, and nut processing operations, as well as employee accommodation and staff catering facilities. This full-time position is based in Hawtat Sudair, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role ensures compliance with SFDA, ISO 22000, HACCP, GMP, PRPs/OPRPs, Halal, and applicable labor-housing and welfare standards. Key Responsibilities Ensure full implementation and monitoring of cleaning and sanitation schedules across all processing areas for coffee, seeds, and nuts, verifying the effectiveness of GMP, PRP, and OPRP procedures. Manage and monitor the pest control program across production, warehousing, staff accommodation, and catering areas, including reviewing contractor reports and escalating recurring issues. Conduct routine hygiene inspections of employee housing, ensuring cleanliness, proper waste management, and pest-free conditions in line with company welfare standards and regulations. Oversee hygiene and food safety practices in staff catering operations, including food storage, preparation, temperature control, and cleanliness of premises and equipment. Monitor CCP/OPRP hygiene checkpoints, coordinate swab and water testing, and review records, escalating deviations immediately. Plan and execute routine food safety and hygiene inspections, GMP walkthroughs, accommodation inspections, catering audits, and periodic mock recalls. Maintain readiness for SFDA and certification body audits, ensuring compliance with regulatory updates affecting food safety and worker housing standards. Train production, catering, and accommodation staff on hygiene practices, CCPs, allergens, traceability, and documentation, leading daily pre-shift GMP briefings. Respond to food safety, hygiene, or sanitation incidents, conduct root cause analysis (RCA), and lead CAPA implementation and tracking. Verify hygiene compliance of catering service providers and raw material handling practices, participating in supplier/vendor hygiene evaluations. Enforce compliance with established hygiene, food safety, and accommodation welfare policies across all shifts and areas, escalating policy breaches to the Quality Manager. Maintain dashboards and KPIs covering hygiene scores, pest control trends, catering audit results, accommodation inspection findings, non-conformance trends, and training coverage. Leadership and Team Supervision This role involves supervising and coaching hygiene, sanitation, and camp-hygiene staff. The supervisor will be responsible for proactive issue identification and resolution across plant, kitchen, and accommodation areas, requiring strong cross-functional coordination with Production, Quality, HR/Admin, and catering vendors. A continuous improvement mindset and discretion in matters affecting employee welfare are essential. Qualifications and Requirements 2-5 years of experience in hygiene supervision or a related field. Demonstrated ability to implement and enforce hygiene SOPs across production, accommodation, and catering areas. Experience with CCP, sanitation, traceability, allergen control, pest control, and Halal assurance procedures. Familiarity with SFDA, ISO 22000, GMP, and applicable labor-housing requirements. Ability to conduct audits and inspections, reviewing the effectiveness of procedures and suggesting updates. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in Hawtat Sudair, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role operates within a dynamic environment that includes food processing facilities, staff accommodation, and catering operations, requiring a calm and structured response under pressure.

f3bd1355719948d0.description: About the Role Alkhorayef Industries Company is seeking a Quality Assurance Specialist to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is essential for maintaining and enhancing the company's quality management systems and operational standards. The specialist will be responsible for ensuring adherence to international quality standards and driving continuous improvement across various functions. Quality Management and Control Review internal Quality Management Systems (QMS) against international standards, identify discrepancies, and propose necessary amendments to align internal processes with adopted standards. Amend QMS activities, processes, and documents to address identified variations and integrate proposed changes into AIC’s Quality Control activities. Ensure effective communication and consistent adherence to approved amendments across all AIC functions. Inspection, Testing, and Corrective Actions Conduct semi-annual reviews of international inspection standards to ensure their adoption in inspection processes. Amend inspection and testing processes and related documents for review and approval by the Quality Manager. Communicate and train the quality team on inspection and testing amendments to ensure understanding and application of approved practices. Review and validate rejection notes from Quality Inspectors, discuss issues with the Engineering team, and issue final actions to relevant departments. Ensure rejected or conceded materials and products are not released without proper justifications and approvals from Quality and Production Managers. Develop and implement corrective-preventative action plans, following up with concerned parties across AIC. Review and validate Reject Notes and Management Review Meeting (MRM) findings post-survey to conduct root-cause analysis and recommend actions to reduce future production rejections. Warranty Case Management Address received warranty claims by assigning quality team members or conducting customer site visits to assess cases and determine next steps. Prepare customer complaint documents, including root-cause analysis and corrective-preventative actions to prevent recurrence. Ensure reports and documents are communicated to the Production Manager for review, validation, and co-approval. Negotiate and agree on warranty case acceptance or rejection with the Production Manager, escalating unresolved cases to the General Manager. Customer and Supplier Relations Oversee the annual creation of customer engagement surveys, secure consensus from department managers, and present for General Manager approval. Collaborate with the After Sales Manager to identify suitable survey types and communication methods for customer feedback. Follow up with the After Sales Manager to collect, collate, report, and analyze customer satisfaction survey results. Develop annual supplier evaluation documents and scorecards, discussing recommendations and action plans with the Purchasing team. Present recommendations at the Management Review Meeting (MRM) based on customer engagement survey analysis and supplier evaluation scores. Communicate supplier scores to the Purchasing Manager for supplier blocking through Finance, as needed. Policy Implementation and Continuous Improvement Ensure control of all procedures and documents through established document control processes to track amendments. Review and approve prepared forms and documents, ensuring control numbers and dates are issued according to policies. Distribute approved documents and forms across AIC functions and ensure the removal of outdated documents in coordination with department managers. Implement approved Quality policies, processes, and procedures, providing instructions to subordinates and monitoring adherence. Contribute to identifying opportunities for continuous improvement in systems, processes, and practices, focusing on leading practices, business process enhancement, cost reduction, and productivity. Support daily activity monitoring to ensure compliance with stipulated policies and procedures. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience.

f3ede1499a7b0ad4.description: About the Role Siemens is seeking a Maintenance Site Manager to join its maintenance organization for the Makkah–Madinah High-Speed Railway (Haramain High-Speed Railway) project. This full-time, permanent position is based in Mecca, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and involves overseeing the maintenance of signalling systems across approximately 450 km of high-speed railway infrastructure. The successful candidate will ensure the safety, reliability, availability, and performance of these systems, while consistently meeting contractual Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and maintenance requirements. Key Responsibilities The Maintenance Site Manager will supervise and coordinate a 24/7 technical maintenance team from one of the maintenance centres along the Makkah–Madinah High-Speed Railway. Responsibilities include: Leading, supervising, and coordinating the site maintenance team and associated technical activities. Ensuring the achievement of contractual maintenance KPIs, including system availability, incident response and repair times, preventive maintenance completion, and reduction of recurring incidents. Ensuring corrective and preventive maintenance activities are performed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with approved procedures and schedules. Coordinating incident response, troubleshooting, fault investigation, and restoration activities. Analysing recurring incidents and implementing appropriate mitigation and improvement measures. Monitoring the operational condition and availability of signalling and associated systems within the assigned area of responsibility. Coordinating activities with other Siemens teams, Maintenance Site Managers, the Project Manager, and relevant project stakeholders. Participating in consortium, customer, and project coordination meetings as required. Coordinating and supervising trackside maintenance activities, inspections, and technical interventions. Ensuring effective management of site resources, including spare parts, tools, equipment, repairs, logistics, and supplies. Maintaining appropriate stock levels and ensuring the availability of critical spare parts and maintenance equipment. Supporting continuous improvement initiatives aimed at increasing system reliability, availability, and maintenance efficiency. Ensuring all activities comply with applicable Siemens, project, customer, and safety requirements. Candidate Profile Candidates should possess 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. The position requires comfort with taking responsibility for a geographically defined maintenance area, coordinating multiple technical disciplines, and managing operational incidents. Collaboration with Siemens teams, consortium partners, and customers is a key aspect of this role. Work Environment The role involves periodic attendance at trackside work locations for inspection, supervision, and coordination of maintenance activities. The successful candidate will be provided with a company vehicle, laptop computer, and mobile phone to perform the role effectively. Application Process Applicants are requested to clearly demonstrate in their application how their qualifications, technical experience, and previous responsibilities align with the requirements of this position.

Ability to navigate narrow, confined, or elevated spaces, and move up and down stairs and/or service ramps. f3c2c3eb200ca916.description: About the Role KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is undertaking a Cybersecurity Transformation Program focused on securing cloud and hybrid environments across its multi-cloud infrastructure. This full-time role for a Cloud Security Engineering Lead, based in Thuwal, Makkah, involves designing, implementing, and assuring secure cloud and hybrid environments. The position requires 5-10 years of experience and combines solution architecture with direct technical execution across various security domains. Role Overview The Cloud Security Engineering Lead will translate security requirements into deployable technical controls, lead complex implementation activities, and resolve cross-platform dependencies. This role ensures solutions are operationally supportable and measurable, working across multiple portfolio initiatives. Key projects include Microsoft 365 A5, Enterprise IAM, cloud security posture improvement, security operations integration, network security, and cyber exposure reduction. The incumbent is expected to remain hands-on in design, configuration, integration, troubleshooting, testing, remediation, and knowledge transfer, while providing technical direction to partners and internal teams. Key Responsibilities Own cloud security architecture and engineering activities from design through implementation, stabilization, and operational handover within the Cybersecurity Transformation Program. Assess Azure, Microsoft 365, hybrid, and multi-cloud environments to identify security gaps and opportunities for control improvement. Design and implement secure cloud architectures aligned with KAUST security principles, enterprise architecture standards, and Zero Trust objectives. Provide hands-on engineering across Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management, Identity Protection, MFA, passwordless controls, Intune, Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Sentinel, and Microsoft Purview. Engineer and improve cloud security posture management, workload protection, attack-path reduction, logging, monitoring, and security configuration across IaaS, PaaS, SaaS, endpoint, and identity environments. Design and implement integrations between cloud platforms and Security Operations, including SIEM/SOAR telemetry, detection use cases, KQL analytics, and incident automation. Apply Zero Trust principles across identity, privileged access, endpoints, applications, network access, collaboration, and data. Develop secure connectivity and access patterns for cloud and hybrid environments, collaborating with network security teams. Lead technical design decisions, configuration reviews, proof-of-concept activities, testing, troubleshooting, and remediation for assigned initiatives. Review and challenge designs proposed by vendors and partners to ensure alignment with KAUST standards. Lead or support migration and modernization activities from legacy security platforms to cloud-native capabilities. Manage technical dependencies with Enterprise IAM, Network Security, Cyber Exposure Reduction, Security Operations, and other teams. Contribute technical leadership to the Microsoft 365 A5 project, including architecture, security configuration, and operational integration. Define technical acceptance criteria, validation evidence, security baselines, and production-readiness requirements. Proactively identify and resolve architecture risks, misconfigurations, security gaps, and implementation blockers. Produce high-quality as-built designs, configuration standards, engineering documentation, and knowledge-transfer materials. Upskill internal technical teams through pairing, technical walkthroughs, and structured knowledge transfer. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Information Technology, Engineering, or a closely related discipline. Substantial equivalent professional experience may be considered. Advanced Microsoft certifications in Azure architecture, security, identity, Microsoft 365 security, or security operations are strongly preferred. Relevant cloud or cybersecurity certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, GIAC cloud security, Microsoft Security certifications, or Google/AWS security certifications are advantageous. Certifications should support demonstrable hands-on enterprise cloud security engineering and implementation experience. Required Skills Deep hands-on cloud security engineering expertise across Microsoft Azure and Microsoft 365, with the ability to move between architecture, configuration, integration, troubleshooting, and operationalization. Strong knowledge of Microsoft security technologies including Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Identity Protection, Defender XDR, Defender for Cloud, Intune, Microsoft Sentinel, and Microsoft Purview. Strong understanding of cloud security architecture across identity, network, endpoint, workloads, applications, data, logging, monitoring, and security operations. Practical experience designing and implementing Zero Trust architectures and identity-centric security controls in enterprise environments. Strong understanding of SIEM/SOAR, detection engineering, KQL or comparable query languages, security telemetry onboarding, incident automation, and SOC integration. Experience with cloud security posture management, workload hardening, attack-path analysis, secure configuration baselines, and remediation across IaaS, PaaS, and SaaS. Ability to design secure hybrid and multi-cloud integrations, including federation, SSO, network connectivity, logging, and security control alignment. Strong technical governance and engineering judgment, including the ability to challenge vendor designs and translate security requirements into practical implementation decisions. Ability to lead multidisciplinary technical teams and delivery partners while maintaining hands-on engagement in critical technical work. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical risks, architecture decisions, and delivery implications to both technical and senior stakeholders. Evidence-led and outcome-oriented approach. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Thuwal, Makkah, within KAUST's dynamic environment, focusing on modern security architectures and sustainable operational handover. The role involves close collaboration with internal teams and delivery partners to modernize security operations, cloud security posture, identity, and network security.

f3cb14af831ba57b.description: About Parfum Christian Dior Parfum Christian Dior maintains high standards of excellence across all aspects of its operations, from product offerings to customer experience. The company is seeking a Stock Keeper to join its team in Makkah or Jeddah, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 0-1 years of experience. Role Summary The Stock Keeper is responsible for ensuring accurate stock management and supporting the smooth daily operations of the boutique. This role involves managing all aspects of boutique stock, including receiving, storage, replenishment, transfers, and inventory control, while upholding Dior's standards. Ensure used testers are properly segregated for warehouse return. Maintain accurate Point of Sale Material (POSM) and merchandise trackers. Manage the movement and storage of POSM and merchandise. Maintain a clean, organized, and secure stockroom. Adhere to Dior and company procedures and internal controls. Collaborate with the Boutique, Warehouse, Logistics, and other relevant teams. Provide support to the boutique during events, inventory counts, and urgent business needs. Demonstrate professionalism, respect, and commitment to Dior values consistently. Qualifications and Experience Previous experience in stock management, inventory, logistics, or retail operations. Experience in the luxury and beauty sectors is an advantage. Good knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel. Strong communication and teamwork skills. Ability to manage multiple tasks effectively in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and organizational skills. Fluency in both Arabic and English.

f334de1ca3c2e3ee.description: About the Role SAB is seeking an Access Control & Cryptography Manager to join its Cybersecurity Department in Riyadh. This full-time role involves leading initiatives related to access management and cryptographic practices within an enterprise-scale financial institution. Key Responsibilities Lead coordination with various bank departments to gather information pertinent to access management and user provisioning. Define and implement effective control mechanisms for access rights, authority delegations, and periodic reviews of user profiles across all systems. Develop, review, and oversee the implementation of access management and cryptographic policies, standards, and controls (*, encryption, hashing, digital signatures), ensuring alignment with regulatory requirements and industry best practices. Ensure policies enforce secure key management and cryptographic practices across all relevant systems and platforms. Manage the definition, maintenance, and review of user access and access matrices across all systems and applications. Review and enhance onboarding processes for new employees, including user account setup, passwords, and access controls. Collaborate with business units during systems implementations or upgrades to define cryptographic keys and access requirements. Assess user access controls during User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and on periodic bases to ensure policy compliance. Supervise security activities related to the SARIE/RTGS system, including access management, RTGS card issuance, and annual certification renewal, to assure compliance with SAMA and Saudi Payment guidelines. Manage the full lifecycle management of cryptographic keys (generation, storage, rotation, archival, revocation, and destruction) to ensure confidentiality and data integrity. Manage the administration of PKI and digital certificates, including issuance, renewal, revocation, and compliance with bank policies and regulatory mandates. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or an equivalent major. Approximately 5 to 10 years of relevant experience, with at least 3 years in a similar role. Experience in an enterprise-scale organization, preferably within the finance or a similarly regulated sector. f362fb37dc2019fd.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قناص العربية المحدودة عن أخصائي تغذية للانضمام إلى فريقها في منطقة عسير، بمدينة احد رفيده. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير برامج التغذية والحمية الغذائية للمرضى والأصحاء، بالإضافة إلى إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بهذا المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة القيم الغذائية والسعرات الحرارية لمختلف أنواع الأغذية وتقدير احتياجات الأفراد من السعرات الحرارية. تحليل برامج الحمية الغذائية المتنوعة واختيار أو إعداد برامج حمية مخصصة للأفراد الأصحاء بناءً على احتياجاتهم الغذائية والحرارية. تطوير برامج تغذية للمرضى داخل المستشفيات، مع الأخذ في الاعتبار توصيات الطبيب المعالج والاحتياجات الغذائية الخاصة بالمرضى. المساهمة في تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات في مجال التغذية. إعداد وتوثيق التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بالتغذية وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة، بما يتوافق مع السياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة خلال تنفيذ جميع أعمال التغذية. المؤهلات والخبرة المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التغذية. القدرة على تحليل البيانات الغذائية وتقدير الاحتياجات الفردية. مهارات جيدة في إعداد التقارير والوثائق. نوع العمل هذا الدور متاح بنظام الدوام الكامل. المنطقة والمدينة يقع مقر العمل في عسير، احد رفيده. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

f366e210cb9919a8.job_title: Field Service Supervisor Services (Saudi National Only)
f366e210cb9919a8.description: About the Role Honeywell Technologies is seeking a Field Service Supervisor Services to lead a team of service technicians in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is specifically for Saudi Nationals and involves overseeing Facilities Management Contracts or large service sites. The supervisor will ensure contractual requirements are met and customer expectations are exceeded, while also contributing individually to chargeable work. The Field Service Supervisor will leverage Honeywell Building Solutions (HBS) tools, processes, and best practices to achieve the team's financial and productivity metrics, maintaining a 100% job chargeable contribution. Identify opportunities for system upgrades, spot service needs, maintenance contract additions, and other sales leads, both individually and with the assigned team. Manage the service team's financial performance, monitoring monthly performance and reviewing available-to-spend versus actuals for contracts. Continuously improve service operational metrics. Ensure the availability of necessary tools, equipment, and materials, while maintaining and controlling inventory levels. Support the implementation and compliance of productivity-enhancing processes related to service delivery within the scope of responsibility. Lead and manage the service team in adopting, implementing, and complying with HBS Global and EMEAI policies, processes, procedures, service tools, and business best practices. Set and implement quality standards (*, quality processes, service manuals, hour reporting) and ensure the service team meets performance expectations. Maximize contract escalation and renewal opportunities against plan and control cancellations at the planned level.
